age.evidence: male Wistar rats, approximately 90 days old

sex.evidence: Eighty animals, male, about 90 days old

dosing.doses_raw: 4 mL/kg (DMT 1.40 mg/mL; HRM 2.43 mg/mL; THH 1.43 mg/mL; HRL 0.10 mg/mL)
dosing.evidence: AYA (or saline solution) was administered via gavage at a dose of 4 mL/kg... The beverage used is composed of 0.10 mg/mL of HRL, 2.43 mg/mL of HRM, 1.43 mg/mL of THH, and 1.40 mg/mL of DMT.

assays.assay_description: 5-min observation in an open field box; time spent in the centre (seconds) recorded as anxiety-like measure. Tested 24 h after LPS/saline injection in both prevention (AYA 1 h before LPS) and treatment (AYA 24 h after LPS) subgroups.

application_type.evidence: AYA (or saline solution) was administered via gavage at a dose of 4 mL/kg

setup_restrain.evidence: observing the animal for 5 min in the open field box

food_restriction.evidence: no food in the open field apparatus during the test

water_restriction.evidence: no water in the open field apparatus during the test

time_to_assay.evidence: Prevention: AYA 1 h before LPS, OFT 24 h after model (~25 h post-AYA). Treatment: AYA 24 h after LPS, OFT 24 h after model (~0 h to 24 h post-AYA depending on counting). 'The open field test was performed 24 h after the completion of the model.'

sample_size.evidence: Eighty animals... divided into control and LPS groups and later into prevention and treatment subgroups; F(3, 32) and F(3, 34) degrees of freedom indicate ~9/group

outcomes.summary: Ayahuasca increased time spent in the centre of the open field in LPS-treated rats in both prevention and treatment subgroups compared to LPS/SAL controls, indicating an anxiolytic-like effect against LPS-induced neuroinflammation.
outcomes.statistics: Prevention: F(3,32)=3.429, p=0.0286 (LPS/AYA vs LPS/SAL p=0.0392); Treatment: F(3,32)=3.16, p=0.0379 (LPS/AYA vs LPS/SAL p=0.0416)
outcomes.evidence: the prevention [F(3,32)=3429, p=0,0286] (p=0.0392) and the treatment [F(3,32)=3,16, p=0,0379] (p=0.0416) subgroups showed an increase in the time spent in the center in the group induced to neuroinflammation and treated with ayahuasca (LPS/AYA) when compared to the group that was only induced to the model disease (LPS/SAL).

B1_num_measures.evidence: evaluating the time, in seconds, that it explores the center of the apparatus

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: single total time in centre over 5 min

B4_ethological.evidence: time in centre is a spatial measure, not ethological

B5_social.evidence: single animal tested alone in open field

B7_automated_classification.evidence: no automated classification described; GraphPad Prism used for stats only

D1_continuity.evidence: The open field test was performed 24 h after the completion of the model

D2_session_duration.evidence: observing the animal for 5 min in the open field box

D3_recording_days.evidence: OFT performed 24 h after the completion of the model

D5_followup.evidence: Prevention: AYA given 1 h before LPS; OFT 24 h after LPS (~25 h post-AYA, ≥24 h)

assays.assay_description: 5-min session in a cylindrical container filled with water (40 cm height); immobility and swimming times recorded as depressive-like measures. Performed 24 h after the open field test.

application_type.evidence: AYA (or saline solution) was administered via gavage at a dose of 4 mL/kg

setup_habituation.evidence: no pre-test exposure to swim cylinder described

setup_restrain.evidence: placed in a cylindrical container filled with water at the height of 40 cm, where they could not touch the bottom or escape

food_restriction.evidence: no food accessible in swim cylinder during test

water_restriction.evidence: no drinking water accessible in swim cylinder during test

time_to_assay.evidence: FST performed 24 h after the open field test (which was 24 h after model completion). Prevention: ~49 h post-AYA; Treatment: ~48 h post-AYA.

sample_size.evidence: Eighty animals... F(3, 34) degrees of freedom indicate ~9-10/group

outcomes.summary: Ayahuasca increased swimming time (i.e., reduced immobility) in LPS-treated rats in both prevention and treatment subgroups compared to LPS/SAL controls, indicating an antidepressant-like effect against LPS-induced neuroinflammation.
outcomes.statistics: Prevention: F(3,34)=22.51, p<0.0001 (SAL/SAL, SAL/AYA, LPS/AYA vs LPS/SAL all p<0.0001); Treatment: F(3,34)=6.369, p=0.0015 (SAL/SAL vs LPS/SAL p=0.0023; LPS/AYA vs LPS/SAL p=0.0078)
outcomes.evidence: a significant increase in the time during which the rats remained swimming in the subgroups SAL/SAL (p<0.0001), SAL/AYA (p<0.0001), and LPS/AYA (p<0.0001), when compared to the LPS/SAL subgroup.

B1_num_measures.evidence: the period of immobility and swimming was recorded

B4_ethological.evidence: FST immobility/swimming not counted as ethological per rubric

B6_cognitive.evidence: FST relies on innate response, no learning required

E8_food_water.evidence: definitionally absent (test apparatus is a water-filled cylinder, no food/drinking water access)

D1_continuity.evidence: The forced swim test performed 24 h after the open field test

D2_session_duration.evidence: They remained in the water for 5 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: FST performed 24 h after the open field test (single session)

D5_followup.evidence: FST performed ~48 h after last AYA administration (≥24 h)

judge_notes: All three candidates agreed on two assays (OFT, FST) — kept as separate entries.

B1 for OFT: only one behavioural measure (time in centre) is explicitly reported → score 0 (matches qwen/gptoss; overrides glm which scored 1 with category '1' — rubric assigns 0 points to category '1').
B1 for FST: immobility + swimming = 2 measures → score 1 (category 2-3); overrides glm's score of 2.
Vehicle for ayahuasca: the beverage itself is the vehicle (decoction) — set to 'other' rather than 'saline' (saline was only used as control substance, not as ayahuasca vehicle).
D5 follow-up for OFT: scored Yes because in the prevention subgroup OFT occurs ~25 h after AYA dosing (≥24 h). Overrides gptoss's No.
time_to_assay set to 'multiple' because prevention and treatment subgroups have different drug-to-test intervals, both addressed within the same assay.
day_night_flipped: paper states 'artificial light cycles (12 h light/dark)' without specifying direction; scored 'no' with medium confidence as standard cycle is the default framing.
